bullets: Cheap readers get far, not far enough. Local OCR + rules reads date and total right 73% of the time at $0, a local 3B vision model 83%, cloud 97 to 98%. On phone photos every reader drops: local 55%, cloud 87%.

The escalation signal, not the model, is the bottleneck. A perfect router would send 27% to the cloud for 98.7%; the rule router sends 56% for 95.7%, and a learned score with AUC 0.89 does no better. The strong cloud tier adds 0.7 points for 2.6x the price: escalate to people, not to a bigger model.

Code catches what the model cannot see about itself. With no answer key the checks caught 38 of the local model's 51 wrong answers and 5 of the cloud's 8. Of 18 that slipped through, 16 were a different printed amount, not a misread. All 16 injections were ignored by every model; every date and arithmetic trap tripped a gate; nothing leaked.
